title: Hybrid-Ready Ba, Automatic Backup Na?
premise: 'Hybrid-ready' means a battery can be added; backup only works with a compatible battery, backup wiring or critical-loads panel, and a backup-configured inverter.
scriptBasis: Claude draft from the 104-episode backlog title/angle, V1.1 brand lines; claims checked online 2026-11-24.

out.chip: Kulang ang setup: brownout pa rin

sources: Sources: Fronius Backup Power Function; SMA Battery-Backup Function

cues.text: Hybrid-ready daw ang inverter mo. May backup ka na ba?
Hindi pa. Ibig sabihin lang, puwede itong lagyan ng battery.
Para gumana ang backup, kailangan ng compatible na battery,
tamang backup wiring o critical loads panel,
at inverter na naka-set up talaga para sa backup.
Kung kulang ang mga 'yan, puwedeng brownout ka pa rin.
Kaya bago bumili, ipa-verify ang buong backup setup.
Dahil ang gusto ni Kuya SoLight… naka-solar ka na, SoSmart ka pa!

claims.wording: 'Hybrid-ready' means a battery can be added; it does not by itself provide backup.

claims.wording: Backup needs a compatible battery, backup wiring or a critical-loads panel, and an inverter configured for backup.
claims.caveats: Exact requirements depend on the model.

onlineCheck.policy: Owner (CHRIS) waived the human technical reviewer for now on 2026-11-24; claims checked online against published data instead.
onlineCheck.note: Manufacturer docs require battery + backup switching/wiring + backup configuration.

claims.wording: Without these, the home can still lose power in a brownout.

onlineCheck.note: Without backup, anti-islanding shuts the inverter down when the grid fails.

sources.title: Net-Metering Rules and Interconnection Standards (Philippine Distribution Code framework)
excerpts: Net-metered systems follow the Philippine Distribution Code and ERC Net-Metering Interconnection Standards, which include islanding protection.

sources.title: Backup power function
excerpts: Backup operation requires a compatible battery and the appropriate backup wiring/switching to separate the home circuits from the grid.

sources.title: Guerilla solar installations need to be controlled, says Philippine power distributor
excerpts: In a compliant system, the inverter must immediately disconnect when the grid goes down to prevent backfeeding electricity into power lines.

sources.title: Battery-backup function
excerpts: Battery-backup operation must be set up and wired as a backup system; not for loads that need an uninterrupted supply.

caption.main:
Hybrid-ready ≠ automatic backup. Para may backup sa brownout: compatible na battery, tamang backup wiring o critical loads panel, at inverter na naka-set up para sa backup. 🔌

SoSmart viewers, naka-hybrid-ready ba ang quote n'yo? 👇
